items.title: Watch party tells you why it will not start
items.text: Opening Watch party from Settings now brings back your kept Stremio account first, and says what is wrong when it cannot start: invites switched off, a Nuvio account, or not signed in to Stremio.

items.title: The original colours are back
items.text: Gold and black is now only the app icon and the logo. Inside the app, the original purple and violet look is back.
